syllabus_topics: Markets, efficiency and the role of the State
GDP and economic growth, innovation and technological progress
Banks, money and credit market; financial crises and globalization
Digital economy, information and social challenges
assessment_rules: For the "normal period" final grade, the exam counts for 50% and continuous assessment for 50%, with a minimum exam grade of 8. For the "resit period" final grade: if absent from the normal period exam, 50% from the resit exam and 50% from projects; if present in the normal period, or projects not done, or final grade decreases with projects, the resit exam counts for 100%. A minimum grade of 8 on the exam is required for the resit period. For the "special period", the exam counts for 100%.
bibliography: Jean Tirole, Economia do Bem Comum, Guerra e Paz, 2018 (main)
Gregory Mankiw, Principles of Economics, Cengage, 8th edition, 2018 (main)
John Komlos, Foundations of Real-World Economics, Routledge, Taylor and Francis Group, 2nd edition, 2019 (main)
John Komlos, Foundations of Real-World Economics, Routledge, Taylor and Francis Group, 3rd edition, 2023 (main)
